items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: I had also formed a quartet with four young Franch musicians, Bernard Estardy, piano, Nino Ferrer, bass, Peter Giger, drums and Charles Barrié, sax-tenor.

ctx.x: or Francis Guillon, and band leader from Poitiers or the Freres Julien, two twins from Sète. Pierre was a talented young alto sax and his brother René was playing bass. I had also formed a quartet with four young Franch musicians, Bernard Estardy, piano, Nino Ferrer, bass, Peter Giger, drums and Charles Barrié, sax-tenor. Whenever I had the chance I would play with my own group but often I would receive propositions from the band leaders mentioned above or from other countries to play soloist with their band.
The 1st of October 1962, I lost my father who had been ill for quite a while. It was as painful for Lily as it was for me. He was a great man. He was 83 years old.
